bio: “Original”, “captivating”, “adventurous” and “regional” sum up the ethos of this cosy urban eatery. As a result, you can expect to sample a mind-blowing range of flavours and savours. Asian flair depicts the semi-cooked salmon, underscored by excellent homemade sambal and flanked by a traditional beurre noisette… A culinary banquet! Ask the lady of the house to show you the popular menu of shared dishes and get ready to embark on an exciting voyage of international flavours in a casual vibe....
